scope: Add fast allocation rollback, same-codec retry, raw group proof, and typed readback for a plain ATTRIB carried by its owning INSERT across the supported DXF revisions.

source.kind: locally generated in-memory DRW_Insert and DRW_Attrib
source.profile: One INSERT with one single-line ATTRIB carrying a nondefault tag, text, insertion/alignment points, height, width scale, rotation, oblique angle, text generation, horizontal/vertical alignment, attribute flags, and field length.

implementation.method: For each revision and encoding, calibrate a successful full-document attributed INSERT write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured allocation, require the seeded destination and complete INSERT/ATTRIB caller state to remain unchanged, retry on the same codec and compare exact bytes, then verify raw ATTRIB fields/owner role and fresh typed INSERT/ATTRIB import readback. R12 Binary uses its one-byte group-code reader.

validation.focusedCTestLog: build-gcc/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log records all 16 revision/encoding profiles and 350 successful injected-allocation rollback/retry/readback checks.

limitations: Generated transaction and same-library self-readback evidence only; producer and native application behavior remain unqualified.
One single-line ATTRIB profile is covered. ATTDEF, embedded multiline ATTRIB, retained Xrecord variants, and outer annotative payloads remain separate profiles.
This exercises ATTRIB through the owning INSERT compound route; no standalone ATTRIB-in-ENTITIES support is claimed.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: A generated one-ATTRIB attributed INSERT now has ASCII/Binary rollback, caller-state preservation, byte-identical same-codec retry, raw owner/field checks, and typed readback across AC1009/AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue exact public-writer inventory and uncovered overload/profile variants; this does not close producer semantics or broader ATTRIB-family support.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 391 completed slices and 32 remaining packages: 391/(391+32)=92.4%; count-based activity proxy only.
